title: Tile Manifest Schema - CARLA Large Map Production
description: Final authoritative tile manifest schema. Generated ONLY after TILESET_FROZEN. All fields are REQUIRED unless marked optional.

parent_xodr_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the parent whole-map XODR this tileset was derived from

parent_structure_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the parent XODR's structural summary (road count, junction count, lane count)

authority_receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the authority receipt (from certify_topology + final_map_readiness_gate)

tile_grid_spec.description: Authoritative grid specification used for this tileset

tile_grid_spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical tile_grid_spec JSON (for tamper detection)

generator_git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the pipeline that generated this tileset

tile_count.description: Total number of tiles in this manifest

tileset_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of all tile files concatenated in sorted filename order

frozen_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when TILESET_FROZEN was applied

validation_status.description: Result of static XODR validation on this tile

constraints.no_duplicate_tile_ids: All tile.id values must be unique
constraints.contiguous_grid: Tile indices must form a contiguous rectangular grid (no holes)
constraints.tileset_digest_matches: tileset_digest_sha256 MUST equal SHA256 of sorted tile SHA256s
constraints.grid_spec_matches: tile_grid_spec_sha256 MUST equal SHA256 of tile_grid_spec object
constraints.parent_xodr_matches: parent_xodr_sha256 MUST match the SHA256 of the actual parent XODR used
constraints.tileset_frozen_marker: A .tileset_frozen marker file MUST exist in the tiles directory with matching tileset_digest_sha256
